central_claim: The paper argues that EMC's inheritance of the published FET-fusion / ATM-suppression / compensatory-ATR-dependency vulnerability is, on public data alone, supported only at a pre-registered WEAK tier: the structural precondition is a sequence argument that survives, while the dependency, drug-response and tumour-signature strands are null or unreadable, and a competing HRD-selected sarcoma ATR programme actively weakens the route.

blockers.summary: PARTIAL CORRECTION, ONE PARAGRAPH WIDE. Round 1 corrected §3.4's GSE24369 probe count from '20,324 (93.2 %)' to '20,629 (98.2 %)'. Two sentences later, in the same paragraph and drawn from the SAME probe_mapping_diagnostic block of the SAME platform in the SAME artifact, the superseded run's values still stand: 'the repaired NCBI chain's own counts are concordant with both §3.2a diagnoses: 4,303 accessions queried -> 4,303 resolved to a nuccore UID (100 %) -> 59 linked to a gene.' The committed artifact at the pin gives ncbi_accessions_resolved_to_a_uid = 4103 (95.4 %, not 4,303 and not 100 %) and ncbi_accessions_linked_to_a_gene = 3163 (not 59) — a factor of 54 on the second number. The provenance is exact, not inferred: artifact commit ce630e2b4 recorded queried 4303 / uid 4303 / gene 59 / mapped 20324 / rate 0.932, i.e. the identical snapshot that produced the '20,324 (93.2 %)' the arithmetic seat corrected. Half of that snapshot was replaced and half was left in place. AND THE SURVIVING HALF CARRIES AN INTERPRETATION THE CORRECTED VALUE REVERSES: the very next clause reads 'the *gene-link* yield is genuinely low because these are ESTs, which is precisely why UniGene — not `elink` — is the right resource for them.' At 3,163 of 4,303 the gene-link yield is 73.5 %, which is not low, so the stated reason for the method choice is refuted by the artifact the sentence cites. The '(100 %)' is false precision in the same breath: the same block still records five elink IncompleteRead / HTTP 502 errors. Nothing in the appendix covers this — row 839 registers only the probe count and the contrast values, and stops at '§3.4'.
blockers.evidence: research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md lines 396-399 at the pin ('4,303 accessions queried -> 4,303 resolved to a nuccore UID (100 %) -> 59 linked to a gene. The UID step works now and returned zero before; the *gene-link* yield is genuinely low because these are ESTs...'); research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json#part_b_emc_tumour_signature.per_platform['GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz'].probe_mapping_diagnostic at the pin: ncbi_n_accessions_queried 4303, ncbi_accessions_resolved_to_a_uid 4103, ncbi_accessions_linked_to_a_gene 3163, ncbi_genes_named 2653, ncbi_mapped 3163, ncbi_errors (5 entries, elink IncompleteRead/502); the same fields at ce630e2b4: uid 4303, gene 59, n_probes_mapped_to_symbols 20324, accession_resolution_rate 0.932 — the superseded snapshot; the corrected sentence two lines above at line 395 already reads '662 to 27,196' and the table at line 387 already reads '20,629 (98.2 %)'.
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Nothing had to break it — it was never fixed. It survives because the arithmetic seat re-derived the numbers the manuscript's TABLE prints and the appendix registers, and this sentence's numbers appear in neither. No lint binds prose numbers to emc-atr-vulnerability.json fields (round-1 arithmetic P1, still open), so the discriminating observation is the artifact's own git history: any pair of numbers in this paragraph that reproduces at ce630e2b4 but not at the pin is an unpropagated half of the same correction.

p1s.summary: The correction register itself is wrong about where the correction lives, in both directions. The canonical-fusion correction (superseded 2026-08-03) is now correctly applied in this paper — line 81 and appendix row 837 both state type 1 = EWSR1 e12::NR4A3 e3, EWSR1(1-431), 8/30 RG as the commonest, and type 2 = EWSR1 e7::NR4A3 e2, EWSR1(1-264), 0/30 as the byte-identical-to-Ewing one — but (a) the companion's Appendix A row still lists the correction's users as emc_fet_idr_census.py, emc-post-degrader-options.md route 1 and target-route-options.md §1.3, and still omits this document, which used the identical superseded phrase and has now been corrected (round-1 consistency P1, unactioned); and (b) emc_fet_idr_census.py's own POINTER block still asserts 'One home for the correction and the superseded value: emc-atr-collaborator-package.md (§2.2 + appendix)', which the round-1 fix made false — there are now two. A register that names the wrong files is the instrument the next drift will be checked against.
p1s.evidence: research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-collaborator-package.md line 543 at the pin ('Used by emc_fet_idr_census.py (emc_canonical_EWSR1_NR4A3), by emc-post-degrader-options.md route 1, and by target-route-options.md §1.3 | ... | those three files, and §2.2 of this document before this revision'); research/modalities/emc_fet_idr_census.py lines 61-68 at the pin; commit e3e6abb8d touched neither file (its diff is 8 files: the manuscript, 5 seat records, hardening-state, research-ledger).
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Already broken by the round-1 fix itself: propagating a correction into a new file without adding that file to the correction's home list is what made the register incomplete. The check that would catch it is the one round 1 filed and did not build — a test that a superseded-value row's 'used by' list matches a repository-wide grep for the superseded phrase.

p1s.summary: The canonical-fusion correction is STILL UNAPPLIED in two of the three files the register names, and in one of them it was APPENDED rather than substituted, so that document now says both things. emc-post-degrader-options.md carries a blockquote correction at lines 291-292 ('the commonest reported EMC fusion is EWSR1 exon 12 :: NR4A3 exon 3, not exon 7') sitting directly above a table whose live row 307 still reads '**EWSR1::NR4A3 (EMC, canonical)** | **1-264** | **0 of 30**', with line 312's headline '**EMC's canonical fusion retains a segment that is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the Ewing...**' and line 1053 unchanged beneath it. target-route-options.md lines 150-152 go further and label the superseded pairing as the fix: 'The corrected canonical junction reproduces model A exactly... EWSR1 exon 7 :: NR4A3 exon 3' — precisely the e7::e3 combination the register says 'pairs the 5' side of one reported type with the 3' side of another and is not itself a reported type' (repeated at line 793). This bears on THIS paper because the paper links to emc-post-degrader-options.md six times and to target-route-options.md once, and its own frontmatter grants the former precedence: 'Route rationale and ranking: emc-post-degrader-options.md route 1, which wins on any disagreement about the plan.' A reader following the paper's own precedence pointer out of the corrected line 81 lands on the uncorrected label. The paper's text is right; the network it points into is not.
p1s.evidence: research/manuscripts/program/emc-post-degrader-options.md at the pin, lines 291-292 (appended correction), 307 (table row, uncorrected), 312 (headline, uncorrected), 1053; research/manuscripts/program/target-route-options.md at the pin, lines 150-152 and 793; research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md frontmatter block, line 43 ('which wins on any disagreement about the plan'), and 6 links to ../program/emc-post-degrader-options.md, 1 to ../program/target-route-options.md.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: It is the append-instead-of-replace failure in its pure form: the corrective note and the corrected claim coexist, each grammatical, and every gate passes because a blockquote naming the right fusion is present in the file. Only a check that the superseded STRING is absent — not that the correct string is present — separates the two.

p1s.summary: The appendix's own home-lists for the two probe-count corrections point at the wrong section and are incomplete, so an auditor re-verifying propagation through the appendix checks the wrong places. Row 840 ('27,195 probes') gives its homes as '§3.4, §6.3, this appendix' — but the third live site is line 574, inside §6.1 ('Tier: WEAK', lines 546-575); §6.3 begins at line 589 and contains no probe count. Row 839 ('20,324 (93.2 %)') gives its home as '§3.4' alone, though 20,324 also stood at line 574 in §6.1. Both corrections WERE applied at line 574 (it reads '27,196 and 20,629 mapped probes rather than from 662'), so this is a defect in the register rather than in the text — but it is the same defect class as the blocker above, one step removed.
p1s.evidence: research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md at the pin: appendix rows 839 and 840; live sites at lines 387, 388, 395, 574, and appendix row 833's 'current' column; section headers at 544 (## 6), 546 (### 6.1), 576 (### 6.2), 589 (### 6.3). p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: A regeneration or a section renumbering; the pointer is prose and nothing validates a bare §N reference against the target section's content (the same guard gap round 1 filed against line 439).

p1s.summary: CARRIED FORWARD, NOT A NEW FINDING: round 1's consistency P1 on line 439 is unapplied at the pin. '§5's limit applies with full force here: the mechanism is a protein recruitment and phosphorylation event at a double-strand break, and no expression matrix can show it' — that limitation is stated in §6.1, not in §5 (Part D, the GDSC2 correlations), and the paper's own headline at line 86 cites it correctly as '(§6.1)'. Recorded here only so the round-2 driver can see it survived a fix commit rather than treat it as newly introduced.

p2s.summary: The FET-arm ATM value is printed as '-0.001' from an artifact delta of -0.0005, while the same sentence-group prints -0.0001 as '-0.000' — two rounding conventions for a half-digit in one paragraph. The correction itself is right (the sign flip from +0.002 to negative is the load-bearing part and it is applied); only the convention is inconsistent. Non-load-bearing: the enclosing bound '|Δ| <= 0.045 with |t| <= 0.71' was not touched by the correction and remains true at the pin (max DDR |Δ| 0.0445, max DDR |t| 0.709).

The PMID correction is stated twice — inline at §8.2 ('the preprint carried PMID 37205599, since superseded, per emc-atr-collaborator-package.md Appendix A') and again as appendix row 838 — so the dead identifier appears in live prose, which CLAUDE.md rule 1.2 ('corrections go in an appendix, not inline') reads against. It is a REPLACEMENT and not an append — the live citation is Gracilla et al., Cancer Research 2026;86:2660-2677, PMID 41811428, and 37205599 survives only inside an explicit 'since superseded' clause — and §3.0a uses the same inline '(Superseded, retained: ... — Appendix.)' pattern, so this is a house convention in this document rather than a slip. Worth a decision rather than a fix.
p2s.evidence: research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md lines 697-701 and appendix row 838; the same pattern at lines 284-285 (§3.0a).

regression_enumeration.hedge_direction_pass: All 31 changed lines compared against their pre-correction form. No qualifier, null, limitation or negation was lost, and one caveat was gained: line 81 replaced an unqualified structural claim with one that names the commonest fusion as 'a weaker, non-identical match to the measured construct'. Every surviving hedge re-verified against the artifact rather than against its earlier wording: '|Δ| <= 0.045 with |t| <= 0.71' still binds (0.0445, 0.709); 'the largest DDR term ... is the DNA-damage checkpoint' still holds in the FET arm (0.1034 vs S-phase 0.0878); 'Four things ... still stand' still matches a four-row table; the §8.3 verdict, its '_sensitivity_bound' and the 'must NOT be read symmetrically' clause are reproduced from the artifact verbatim. The unchanged GSE4303 contrast table (9 concepts x raw and proliferation-adjusted) was re-derived in full against the artifact and is correct, so the correction did not leave a half-updated table beside it. pinned-figures.json contains none of the corrected values, so rule 1.2's same-commit registration requirement was not engaged.
